_comment: JX-3P per-synth config (E4/S0 form). KNOWN values are filled; DERIVED-IN-S2 values are null until the oracle + IDA dump land, and must not be guessed. The JUNO's are in synth/juno60.json.
name: jx3p
_bank_geometry: KNOWN from S1: the JX bank is a byte-compatible container with the JUNO -- exactly 23 + 20223*64 = 1294295 bytes, names decode with juno_bank_patch_name.
_patch_byte_layout: DERIVED-IN-S2, not assumed. Script.xml gives the PARAMETER ADDRESS SPACE (page:offset SysEx-style), NOT the on-disk bank byte offsets. The JUNO proved these differ; the JX offsets (which byte is DELAY TYPE, etc.) come from perturb-and-diff under the oracle. Placeholders below stay null.
_state_layout: DERIVED-IN-S2 from the IDA dump: the flat per-object state stride, voice cells, scatter cells. The JX has TWO DCOs (DCO1+DCO2 with cross-mod) where the JUNO had one, so the voice state is larger -- do not copy the JUNO's stride.
_param_surface: KNOWN from Script.xml: 290 parameters, 43 audible. Full inventory in jx3p/docs/param_inventory.json. Encoding is int2x4 nibble-pair dominant, as JUNO. ASSIGN MODE range 0,2 (UNISON at 2). CONDITION range 0,255 default 128.
